title: Andrew Davies (Ex-CEO, B Lab AU/NZ) — 'Read Incorruptible. It's part history, part toolkit, and Part III on how a business can change the systems around it is where I'd start'
summary: Andrew Davies — Ex-CEO of B Lab AU/NZ, SILA & Vincent Fairfax Fellow — publishes a post-CEO Climate Week reflection. Frames Incorruptible as the antidote to Climate-Week pessimism, gives a specific starting-chapter recommendation (Part III), and connects it to his post-B-Lab view that certification is 'often necessary, but rarely sufficient on its own.' 54 likes.
blockquote: Some of that is from Eric Ries new book, Incorruptible. It's full of stories of businesses built around a clear purpose, that went on to create value over decades. Cadbury. John Lewis. Vanguard. Costco. What stayed with me is how old most of this wisdom is. We didn't discover it. We lost it somewhere in the last 50 years of management theory. If you lead a business and you're feeling the weight of the headlines, read Incorruptible. It's part history, part toolkit, and Part III on how a business can change the systems around it is where I'd start. Then ask yourself one question: if your purpose was tested tomorrow, what in your strategy or structure would help you hold to it?
